title: Rotation and Key setup at level 27
caption: You asked for a Simple mode. It's the Rotation section at the top of Build, always open; the keys and macro are in the Key setup fold under it (one view).

title: Key setup: icons, your keys, the macro
caption: At level 27 each key box is the skill's icon (name on hover), you can set your own key per stack, and the macro shows as its steps.
